If below 25% max hp, your high-damaging kido attacks have a chance to inflict electroshock ({{kido_cd}}s CD)

charms.name: Aura Of Terror
charms.description: Manual spiritual pressure is replaced with an AOE attack that inflicts a terrifying status effect on enemies hit and deal {{hp_dmg}} max HP damage ({{cd}}s CD)

charms.name: Adrenaline Junkie
charms.description:
Gain 1% output on hit up to 107% (not including multi hit techniques). If you do not get hit/hit an enemy for 30 seconds, automatically return to 100%.
 Lose 1% output when getting hit, down to 10%

charms.name: Await The Opening
charms.description:
Your parries now posture break.
 Your parries are worth {{parry_dmg}} as much posture damage

charms.name: Blazing Spirit
charms.description:
Parrying a basic melee attack ignites your blade with spirit flames ({{cd}}s CD, +{{dmg_buff}} damage)
 Basic Melee attacks not ignited by flame deal reduced damage (-{{dmg_debuff}}% damage)

charms.name: Blademaster
charms.description: Your bladed basic attacks inflict deep gash stacks on your opponent. Your bladed basic attacks deal {{dmg_reduction}} less damage. Upon reaching {{deep_gash_amount}} deep gash stacks, deal {{deep_gash_dmg}}% of all the damage you would have done normally.

charms.name: Curtain Call
charms.description:
As long as your reiatsu is at {{rei_amount}}, your basic attacks have percent lifesteal 
 You no longer passively regenerate reiatsu

charms.name: Flawless Swordsman
charms.description:
Dealing damage without being hit will build 'Perfection', whilst Perfection is building gain up to a {{dmg_buff}} damage buff towards enemies, at half stacks or more all damage is fire damage.
Suffering a hit or leaving combat will extinguish your flame of ambition, losing all stacks. Leaving a cooldown of 10s before your next attempt.

charms.name: Haze of Death
charms.description: Your critical attack applies Cursed ({{cd}}s CD)

charms.name: Heavenly Restriction
charms.description:
Your physical attacks are up to {{dmg_buff}} more potent, scaling with level
 You have {{aura_gain}} more aura gain, scaling with level
 You gain {{max_ap}} more max AP and {{shunpo_buff}} more shunpo speed and stamina. You gain up to {{move_speed}} more movement speed
 You slightly gain melee defense and kido defense
 Your aura is on a shorter cooldown and you gain more output in aura
 Your critical attacks now auto-execute. You do more damage towards riposte and you cannot be sensed
 You cannot use abilities to any capacity
 (Does not fully stack with Warrior's Spirit)

charms.name: Kill Confirmed
charms.description:
Knocking an opponent will cause them to succumb to your spiritual pressure and cause their head to blow off 
Blowing their head off will reduce your output by {{debuff}} (Scaling with nearby enemies) temporarily

charms.name: Last Man Standing
charms.description:
If an ally is to be knocked within 90 meters of you, siphon the enemies HP pack and gain a percent of it yourself 
Your regeneration from all sources is cut in half

charms.name: Monster Slayer
charms.description:
For every nearby NPC enemy gain a stack of 'Slayer', up to 10 stacks 
 For every stack of 'Slayer' gain {{monster_dmg}}% more Monster Damage, increasing up to 3.5 times 
 While you have 'Slayer' stacks: at 3 stacks gain weaker Curtain Call, at 4 stacks become immune to movement slow, and at 6 stacks your Curtain Call strengthens 
 When you're put in combat by a player, all 'Slayer' stacks are rendered invalid

charms.name: Quick Grit
charms.description: Landing 3 different non-barrage attacks on the same person within {{window}}s smites the opponent, granting a {{dmg_buff}} damage buff on the most recent attack ({{cooldown}}s CD)

charms.name: Raid Boss
charms.description:
Your aura cooldown is shortened
 For every nearby PLAYER enemy gain a stack of battle fever, for every nearby PLAYER ally lose a stack of battle fever, up to 10 stacks
 For every stack of battle fever gain {{aura_buildup}} more aura buildup. While your Aura is active, this instead boosts your Spiritual Pressure's power level, both increasing up to 3.5 times
 While your Aura is active: at 3 stacks gain weaker Curtain Call, at 4 stacks become immune to movement slow, at 6 stacks your Curtain Call strengthens, finally at 7 stacks your m1s periodically proc Perfect Flash
 When your battle fever is empty and allies are nearby take 10% more damage

charms.name: Ruler's Gaze
charms.description:
Performing a guard break activates "Geass".
Whilst "Geass" is active, issue a command to the opponent to halt, allowing for a longer follow up. "Geass" cannot be used on the same target twice, and has a cooldown. Being in "Aura" ignores the first restriction.

charms.name: Shonen Syndrome
charms.description:
Yell out the move you are about to use 
 Upgrades the move by {{levels}} levels (Does not work past level 6)
 {{cd}} second cooldown between upgrades

charms.name: Struggler's Spirit
charms.description:
Landing three basic attacks when below {{hp_percent}} HP will balster your strength ({{cd}}s CD)
 You take {{dmg_reduction}} less damage when your health is below 25%

charms.name: Soul Snatcher
charms.description:
Landing any kido ability on a opponent who is less than {{hp_percent}} HP will activate Soul Snatcher
 Enemies with Soul Snatcher activated on them will immediately be knocked after a short delay

charms.name: The Incapable
charms.description:
Your innate base output is up to {{base}} depending on level, this goes up to {{max_base}} based on missing HP
 Gain access to a reliquary attached to your waist, this is the source of your power. It glows based on missing HP
 You can no longer use transformations or racial abilities, and effects of hollow traits are disabled
 You can not access your racial progression boss fights

charms.name: Undying Soul
charms.description:
Unleash a second wind when defeated, become ungrabbable in this state
 Your death is certain when your health runs out

charms.name: Ultimate Sacrifice
charms.description:
Break your current limits and go beyond when popping Aura 
 Your rage is born from deep within your heart. Nothing can stop it (Uncancellable Aura)

charms.name: Warrior's Spirit
charms.description:
{{dmg_buff}} melee damage increase on basic attacks

charms.name: You're In My Range
charms.description:
{{gap_defense}} defense towards gap-close abilities
 Your next basic attack or critical is empowered after being attacked by a gap-close ability (45s CD)

charms.name: Jack-o-Lantern
charms.description:
Maiming a player forces them to wear a pumpkin head. The pumpkin head remains for 1 minute until it explode. For each kill, you gain a jack-o'-lantern (max 3) that hovers behind you. When taking a lethal blow you consume a jack-o'-lantern and heal.
 You now grip players 2.5x slower
 You now maim enemies 1.25x slower

charms.name: Backline Buster

charms.name: No Time To Spare
charms.description: Once put into combat, gain the effecs of light feet until you are hit.

charms.name: Close and Personal
charms.description:
{{dmg_buff}} weapon/hakuda damage
 {{dmg_debuff}} damage vulnerability

charms.name: Deep Hatred

charms.name: Factotum's Spirit
charms.description:
{{xp_gain}} increased EXP gain
 {{xp_loss}} increased EXP loss

charms.name: Frostwalker
charms.description:
Dealing a high-damage kido blow will embue you in frost, this effect lasts {{frost_duration}}s or until consumed
 While frosted your next basic attack will freeze your opponent (25s CD) 
 While frosted, lose {{speed_debuff}} movespeed

charms.name: Frugal
charms.description:
You lose 80% less cash from dying to players
 You don't gain cash from players

charms.name: Golem
charms.description:
Taking {{dmg_amount}}+ base damage withing 2.5s will activate rock armor for {{duration}}s (45s CD)
 While rock-armored, gain {{dmg_resist}} damage resistence

charms.name: Heat Burst
charms.description:
Replaces your Aura with Heat
 When Heat activates, automatically heal {{heal}} of your maximum health and gain max AP

charms.name: Indomitable Spirit
charms.description:
Gain {{hp}} of your health back from winning clashes
 Lose {{hp_loss}} of your health upon losing clashes

charms.name: Lizard's Spirit
charms.description: When your health reaches below {{hp_amount}}, heal {{heal}} (9m CD)

charms.name: Marshland King
charms.description:
Build aura {{buildup}} faster, and unleash a menacing laugh when popping it

charms.name: Merchant's Blessing

charms.name: Mysterious Stranger (Her)

charms.name: Mysterious Stranger (Him)
charms.description: The mysterious stranger has a {{chance}} chance to aid you when dealing physical damage (30s CD)

charms.name: Nowhere to Hide
charms.description:
Striking an opponent below {{player_hp}} HP while you are above 50% HP will cause them to be revealed for 5s

charms.name: Overtime Hours
charms.description:
During a mission, if the clock runs down below 75% of the starting time you start running off overtime 
 During overtime, gain 6.5% output and continue to gain it for every invader that joins

charms.name: Perfect Flash
charms.description: Landing a melee Basic/Critical attack out of combat deals {{dmg_buff}} dmg, this also applies to full-hp opponents (60s CD)

charms.name: Presence of Mind

charms.name: Poison Touch

charms.name: Ranged Warrior

{{dmg_buff}} kido/ranged damage 
 {{dmg_debuff}} damage vulnerability

charms.name: Reality Warper

charms.name: Side Character

Deal {{dmg_buff}}% more damage to NPCs

charms.name: Superiority Complex
charms.description:
Blade-catching an opponent will cause you to mock them, increasing aura gain on the blade catch ({{cd}}s CD)

charms.name: Surgeon's Spirit
charms.description:
All heals towards you are increased by {{heal_buff}}

charms.name: Swarm
charms.description: Landing your critical attack will spawn {{spawn_amount}} friendly Dragonfly Hollow

charms.name: Train Conductor

Steal a mission ticket when killing an enemy player who has one

charms.name: Tools of the Trade
charms.description: You have absolute mastery over your weaponry, your heavy attack is never red, gain riposte on the attack anyway (Does not work for heavy attacks that are never red to begin with)

charms.name: Tooth & Nail

charms.name: Vice It

charms.name: Wraith's Spirit

charms.name: Dracula's Fangs
charms.description:
Grips now give you {{grip_heal}} more hp back

 This will turn you into a.. VAMPIRE!!

charms.name: Dead Man Walking

Taking heavy amounts of damage within a short timeframe will now cause you to lose skin.. slowly turning you into a skeleton.

charms.name: Witches Brew
charms.description:
Popping aura now makes you consume a potion of poison allowing you to proc poison on all attacks when in aura.

charms.name: At the Ready
charms.description: Gain permanent {{haste_buff}} ability haste when invaded

charms.name: Battle Hardened
charms.description: You visually bleed on hits at lower health

charms.name: Critical Blows
charms.description: {{dmg_buff}} increased critical attack damage

charms.name: Defensive Regen

You regenerate {{rei_regen}} more reiatsu from parries

charms.name: Domination
charms.description: Max AP is increased by {{ap_buff}}

charms.name: Fortified Fighter

charms.name: Flashmaster
charms.description: {{shunpo_stam}} shunpo stamina

charms.description:

skillTree.flavorText: Give buffs to others, while debuffing monsters. This applies the Inner fire monster dmg buff and healing salve buff to people around you.

skillTree.name: Soul Ward
skillTree.flavorText: Shield nearby party members with a barrier that absorbs incoming damage, protecting them from statuses and executes until it breaks.

skillTree.name: Guiding Light
skillTree.flavorText: Bless nearby party members, increasing their health, reiatsu and defense. You are blessed as well if at least one ally is.

skillTree.name: Lifeline
skillTree.flavorText: Revive downed party members around you, restoring a portion of their health.

skillTree.name: Inner Fire
skillTree.flavorText: Increase your haste by 10%, monster dmg by 7% and reiatsu regen for 2 minutes. The effects and durations are cut in half if used in combat.

skillTree.name: Aerial Fighter
skillTree.flavorText: Hold run while using your critical attack to launch an opponent into the air

skillTree.name: Rushdown
skillTree.flavorText: Flashstep after applying heavy knockback to someone, or knock someone into the air to teleport to them

skillTree.name: Drop Cancel
skillTree.flavorText: Flashstep right before landing to cancel the stun

skillTree.name: Spiritual Potential
skillTree.flavorText: Gain the ability to fill up your aura bar when fighting players. Once filled, you can unleash your spiritual pressure and gain a short-term buff

skillTree.name: Spiritual Pressure
skillTree.flavorText: Flex your spiritual power, affecting weaker opponents to varying degrees

skillTree.name: Manual Rushdown
skillTree.flavorText: Hold shift and flashstep to manually use rushdown on a target with added startup

skillTree.name: Slippery Fighter
skillTree.flavorText: Press Counter after winning a clash to launch your opponent into the air

skillTree.name: Overhead Counter
skillTree.flavorText: Counter weapon-based overhead swings on deflect, increasing the enemies posture significantly

skillTree.name: One Way Ticket To Hell
skillTree.flavorText: Winning a clash when the opponent is low on health and high on posture will cause you to impale them with your fist

skillTree.name: Advanced Counter
skillTree.flavorText: Counter specific melee attacks with your foot, increasing the enemies posture significantly

skillTree.name: Clash Proficiency
skillTree.flavorText: Winning a clash when the opponent is low on health and medium posture initiates an execution

skillTree.name: Sterbe
skillTree.flavorText: Fire two arrows, blasting your opponent away with the second. If both connect, flash step after them. Portals open around them and riddle them with blasts before you land a final explosion.

upgradeEffects.text: The barrage triggers if only the second arrow connects

skillTree.name: Schnellepfeile
skillTree.flavorText: Fire a point-blank arrow. If it connects or is blocked, flash step behind your opponent and fire two more.

upgradeEffects.text: The final arrow knocks back on hit and block

skillTree.name: Breakthrough
skillTree.flavorText: A quick dash forward that cuts through anyone in your path. Connecting, even into a block or parry, lets you recast for up to 3 dashes, each travelling further than the last.

upgradeEffects.text: During your third dash, press Counter to send a clone forward in your place, freeing you to act. The clone deals no damage, but stuns through block

skillTree.name: Behind You
skillTree.flavorText: After a successful blade catch, press Counter again once your opponent is thrown back to vanish behind them, holding them in place for a barrage of slashes.

skillTree.name: Bala Trick
skillTree.flavorText: Kick your opponent off balance and plant a ring of balas around them with a flurry of strikes. Shortly after the last one, fire a quick cero beam that detonates them all at once.

upgradeEffects.text: The cero beam detonation can auto-execute

modifiers.name: Celestial
modifiers.stat: Max Rei, Health | Kido, Melee Def | Posture regen

upgradeEffects.text: When using "Unlimited Arsenal" a clone of you will spawn, also using the technique (Requires 75% or more inspiration).
When using "Spikes" a clone of you will spawn, also using the technique (Requires 75% or more inspiration).
The inspiration requirement is lowered from 90% to 75%.
"Spikes" will ignore crumple and ragdoll.
"Spikes" and "Debris Prison" cause bleed.
While the "Enlightened" status effect is active, deal more damage with Kido skills.
The execution threshold for "Reality Bending" is increased from 12.5% -> 16%.
All of The Superstar's damaging moves will give you a rushdown follow-up.
Star Flash is capable of disintegrating opponents.
When posture broken, your fan will swap places with you to protect you.
When you are killed, your fan will give their life to save you.
At half popularity or more, each cheer heals you slightly.
Your output boost per cheer lasts significantly longer.

variants.name: Darkheart
variants.description: Your flames deal much less damage, but siphon Reiatsu instead. Also changes flame color to black.

upgradeEffects.text: At high temperatures light your arms ablaze, enhancing ability damage and generating more heat over time. (requires 60% Heat Meter)
While your arms are ablaze, deal flame damage on melee attacks, increasing damage by 7.5%. (This gives a ~1.15 dmg multiplier to m1s)
At above average temperatures your moves cause full body incineration (burn damage is applied on moves).
Your turbulent heat can turn low health enemies into ash, requires temperature to be at 60% or higher.
Your first & second finger are compatible with rushdown.

passives.name: Heat
passives.description: You are given an heat bar, which increases through hitting m1s or by using/hitting your ability's skills. This bar is used to change the moves and to proc some of the passives.

moves.name: First Finger - Control M1 (Below 50% Heat)
moves.description: Swipe upwards with your hands ablaze, knocking opponents into the air. Gives 15% heat on use, and an extra 25% on hit.

moves.name: Second Finger - Control M1 (Above 50% heat)
moves.description: Fire a blast of heat from your finger. This consumes 50% of your heat bar, granting 25% back upon landing it.

moves.name: Third Finger - Control M2 (Below 50% heat)
moves.description: Unleash 2 powerufl fire slashes. Gives 15% heat per slash, with each one grantting 25% extra heat uppon landing (Totals to 80%).

moves.name: Fourth Finger - Control M2 (Above 50% heat)
moves.description: Conjure a balista of flame (Fuga). Consumes 70% heat, granting 40% back if landed.

variants.name: Frost Lord
variants.description: Your army of the undead is made from frost, lowering their health but giving their attacks a small chance to freeze opponents. Changes the color of your undead to a lighter blue/white with frozen effects.

upgradeEffects.text: You are immune to damage from summoned NPCs
Successfully sealing NPCs will heal you.
Taking damage will redirect 30% of it towards any active NPCs
Your NPCs will heal you when dealing damage (1% per 20 base damage)

moves.name: Power Seal - Control M1
moves.description: After killing an enemy, you can seal them, replacing your current sealed npc

moves.name: Arise - Control M2
moves.description: Summons your currently sealed npc, attacking nearby enemies

variants.description: Less drain during portals, deal slightly less damage from 'Tear the Skies'. Changes color to orange-purple.

upgradeEffects.text: Gain damage reduction for a short time period after manually activating 'Exit Gate'
You no longer suffer from output reduction when leaving 'Alternate Dimension'
When out of combat, your 'Alternate Dimension' portal will drain for less reiatsu
When landing the initial attack from 'Alternate Dimension', you experience no reiatsu drain in your portal for a brief period.
When an opponent who is very low on health is struck by 'Tear the Skies', they have their time/space warped and are stunned for much longer by hits of the blitz

moves.name: Alternate Dimension - Control M1
moves.description: Throw a punch, then enter an alternate dimension, becoming invisible and invencible. While inside it, your reiatsu will be drained at a high speed, if you re-cast the move or your reiatsu runs out, you exit your dimension.

moves.name: Tear the Skies - Control M2
moves.description: Teleport to an opponent before rapidly blitzing around.

variants.name: Dragon Thunder
variants.description: "Thunder Spear" is slower, but has increased damage and range. Also changes color to pinkish-orange.

variants.name: Blue Jets
variants.description: "Electric Blitz" is faster, but has an increased reiatsu cost. Also changes color to blue.

upgradeEffects.text: Gain an empowered flash step periodically when at or above 25% conductivity, which increases your conductivity.
Restart your heart using your lightning when in dire straits, allowing one extra hit.
Your high-damaging skills apply shock.
Apply Electrocution (a high intensity stun) when high conductivity and landing a schrift skill.
You can rushdown off of "Thunder Spear".
When taking a high burst of damage, spend 25% of Conductivity to reduce the damage.

moves.name: Thunder Spear - Control M1
moves.description: Throw a spear made of thunder at your opponent, knocking them away

moves.name: Electric Blitz - Control M2
moves.description: Run forward while dischargin lightining at your opponent

variants.name: Heavenly
variants.description: Ability attacks gain lifesteal at the cost of damage (20% Less Damage, 30% Lifesteal on moves). Also changes colors from black and white to purple/green/yellow.

upgradeEffects.text: Cleaver's blade volley cuts for longer.
Cleaver's cut aoe follows targets briefly now.
After landing "Cleaver" at least twice, begin a chant to empower "Cleaver" every time you land it, until you land three in a row, doubling your damage on the third cast.
Completing the chant will also heal you slightly (around 30 health).
Your techniques induce blood loss (increases bleed duration).
Bleeding the same enemy 3 times using blademaster moves will proc deep gash on them (effect unknown).

moves.name: Cleaver - Control M1
moves.description: Slice opponents in range with multiple slashes

moves.name: Butcher - Control M2
moves.description: Grab your opponent, sending a barrage of slashes at them before tossing them away.

variants.name: Ruby
variants.description: Metal infusions cause bleeding and deal more impact damage, but they cause less stun. Also changes color to red.

variants.name: Opal
variants.description: The final hit of "Metal Spikes" can catch opponents on fire, but the technique's cooldown is increased. Also changes color to orange.

variants.name: Amethyst
variants.description: "Demolition Man" costs less reiatsu to cast, but "False Arm" has a slightly longer cooldown. Also changes color to purple.

variants.name: Emerald
variants.description: "False Arm" lasts an extra hit, but the active duration is decreased. Also changes color to green.

variants.name: Diamond
variants.description: "Demolition Man's" close ranged attack causes concussions, but deals much less damage. Also changes color to light blue.

variants.name: Sapphire
variants.description: All ability techniques cost more reiatsu, but have shorter cooldowns. Also changes color to blue.

upgradeEffects.text: "False Arm" lasts for a longer duration
If two "Demolition Man" projectiles land, infuse the opponent with metal
The third hit of "Metal Spikes" will infuse the opponent with metal
All iron-based attacks will cause bleeding
"False Arm" will break after 3 hits instead of 2
Whilst "False Arm" is active, take 10% less damage

moves.name: False Arm - Control M1
moves.description: Reinforce your hand with iron, increasing the next 2 hits of damage.

moves.name: Demolition Man - Control M1
moves.description: While 'False Arm' is active, recasting the move will make you trow your iron coating as shrapnel (3 projectiles) at your opponent

moves.name: Metal Spikes - Control M2
moves.description: Perform a three hit combo using spikes on your arms

upgradeEffects.text: Both "Shadow Game" and "Mountain Game" will deal more damage to the opponent if they lose
"Shadow Game" and "Mountain Game" can execute opponents on a loss
Your normal critical attack is always "Bushogoma"
Both "Shadow Game" and "Mountain Game" have a longer duration.
Build charge towards your ultimate, "Irooni", is much faster during Shikai mode.

passives.name: Weapon
passives.description: Having this ability will lock you to the dual swords weapon

moves.name: Shadow Game - Control M1
moves.description: Forces your oppoent into a game, having it's duration represented by a bar. In this game, both of you will have their shadows visible and the first one to step on another's shadow wins, hitting them with a barrage of slashes and ending the game.

moves.name: Shadow Slash - Control M1
moves.description: While in shadow game, pressing Control M1 will make you dive into your shadows, teleporting to your opponent and unleashing a powerful slash after

moves.name: Shadow Fall - Control M2
moves.description: While in shadow game, pressing Control M2 will make you dive in your shadows, appearing in front of your opponent

moves.name: Mountain Game - Control M2
moves.description: Force you and your opponent into a game. Whoever is higher by the end of it winds, the loser being hit with a barrage of slashes.

moves.name: Takeoni - Control M1
moves.description: While in mountain game, pressing Control M1 will make you leap forward, unleashing a powerful strike.

moves.name: Flash Flip - Control M2
moves.description: While in shadow game, pressing Control M2 will make you leap back into the air, gaining height over your opponent.

passives.name: Bushogoma
passives.description: Your critical is now replaced by bushogoma (Scales with kido)

moves.name: Irooni - Control M2
moves.description: Landing enough hits in mode will make your character flash white, replacing your M2 with Irooni.

variants.name: Normal
variants.description: Changes your Shikai weapon to Odachi / Longsword

variants.name: Katana
variants.description: Changes your Shikai weapon to Katana

upgradeEffects.text: When your blade is halfway to reaching a blossom or higher, your petal-related abilities deal a petal aftercut.
If your blade is fully blossomed, aftercuts will finish off low health opponents by slicing them to pieces.
You dance with elegance. When your blade is fully blossomed all neutral parries become perfect.
All manual perfect parries extend the duration of your blossom mode slightly.
Send your petals after an opponent if you knock them back from a blade catch.
Wave of Blossoms will downslam on hit and build much more blossom meter, if your meter is already above 30%

passives.name: Weapon
passives.description: You are locked to using this abilities variant weapon (Longsword or Katana)

moves.name: Petal Dance - Control M1
moves.description: Throws forward an circle of flowers, which deal continuous damage to anyone inside it.

moves.name: Bladescatter - Control M1
moves.description: While petal dance is out, pressing control m1 will divide the circle of flowers torward your cursor.

moves.name: Encircle - Control M2
moves.description: While petal dance is out, pressing control m2 will move the circle of flowers to your cursor, making it bigger and dealing more damage.

moves.name: Wave of Blossoms - Control M2
moves.description: Send forward a powerful wave of petals, crumpling any opponents hit by it

passives.name: Blossoming
passives.description: Gain a bar which fills up by dealing damage. When full, you'll enter your sub-mode

passives.name: Weapon
passives.description: While in the sub-mode, your m1's and critical are changed.

moves.name: Final Act - Control M2
moves.description: While in the mini mode, rush forward, swinging twice then blink forward, creating a thousand cuts between (This move can only be used once per sub-mode pop).

upgradeEffects.text: Gain +3.5% output briefly after using "Split Apart." This effect is doubled below 35% HP
Gain 10% damage reduction at all times when your shikai is active below 25% HP
The Last hit of any shikai weapon skill will make your next weapon swap much faster
The last hit of "Three Piece Assault" or the last two hits of "Demon's Call" will execute opponents
Enables rushdown on the last hit of "Three Piece Assault" and the Flail's critical attack
All slashes produced (not barrages) from ability techniques causes bleeding

passives.name: Weapon - Spear
passives.description: Demon light locks you onto three types of weapons, which are alternated by using the move Split Apart. One of them being the spear, which remains unchanged from a normal one.

passives.name: Weapon - Flail
passives.description: The second weapon is a Flail, which is a weapon exclusive to this ability. The critical pulls enemies to you.

passives.name: Weapon - Nunchucks
passives.description: The third weapon are Nunchucks, which is a weapon exclusive to this ability. The critical does multiple slashes around you, with a powerful one at the end (Does not apply hit stun).

moves.name: Split Apart
moves.description: Using this move will switch your weapons (Spear -> Flail -> Nunchucks).

moves.name: Three Piece Assault - Control M2
moves.description: While having the spear, pressing Control M2 will unleash 3 consecutive strikes.

moves.name: Double Bullseye - Control M2
moves.description: While having the flail, pressing Control M2 will send out 2 projectiles, which ricochet to nearby enemies.

moves.name: Demon's Call - Control M2
moves.description: While having Nunchucks, pressing Control M2 will do a similar attack to your critical, however having an extra slash at the end

upgradeEffects.text: Ink moves will apply an ink trail onto your blade which increases damage and stun dealt.
'Sever' applies Inked on hit for 3 seconds.
Open a bursting ink puddle under your opponents who are blade caught.
'Sever' will disable your player enemy skills for 6s.
Gain access to 'Brush Strike' after using Sever.
'Brush Strike' is rushdown-compatible.

variants.name: Gateway
variants.description: Increased range, longer marker duration. Less damage from "Rift" and Mark Destination variant

variants.name: Cosmic
variants.description: Longer duration during rift, less range on teleports

upgradeEffects.text: Landing "Rift" will mark the opponent, granted you don't have an active marker
Manual Rushdowns will create a marker from the start point automatically granted "Mark Destination" is off cooldown
You can feint your teleport, transporting a bomb to it (ground marker only)
You can perform a flip kick after teleporting to a opponent, if you use press Counter during "Warp" startup
Landing "Rift" when the opponent is nearby a marker will cause it to detonate
Your waypoints are fully concealed, unless they're on a person
Reduce incoming damage while in range of your waypoints, this effect is more potent for ground markers

moves.name: Mark Destination (Ground Variant) - Control M1
moves.description: Places a mark on the flor to return to later

moves.name: Mark Destination (Enemy Variant) - Control M1
moves.description: When used close to an enemy, punch the opponent leaving the mark on them, also knocking them away. The mark is not applied if the opponent blocks.

moves.name: Warp - Control M1
moves.description: Teleports you back to your marker's position, as long as you are inside the mark's bubble.

moves.name: Rift - Control M2
moves.description: Summon an orb above the opponent, causing shrapnels to rain down (auto tracks)

variants.name: Bluebell
variants.description: Apply a burning DOT on flame damage instead of a flat increase. Also changes color to a light blue.

upgradeEffects.text: You can incinerate the limbs of people at low health with flame moves, dealing extra damage.
'Flame Surge' will incinerate people who are extremely low health.
Your shunpo leaves trails of fire behind you while reiatsu is above 70%, increasing speed
Increased shunpo speed while trails are active, and reiatsu threshold is reduced to 30%
If flame damage is parried it will inflict 'Sweating' onto the enemy
While form is active: Light your blade aflame when your reiatsu is above 40%

passives.name: Burn
passives.description: Your moves apply burn, increasing your move's damage

moves.name: Flame Surge - Control M1
moves.description: Stab your sword into the ground, making it erupt later, sending your opponents flying (Allows rushdown).

moves.name: Prominence Slicer - Control M2
moves.description: Run forward, leaving a track of flames behind you, at the end, unleash a high damaging slash.

variants.name: Red Ice
variants.description: Lower damage, increased freeze time. Also changes color to red.

upgradeEffects.text: Dashing through attacks has a bigger window and will leave an ice clone (10s cd)
Using rushdown will create an ice shockwave around you that will freeze nearby enemies, with duration depending on their health. (FORM ONLY)
Using ice moves will leave a cold mist on your blade which inflicts more stun

passives.name: Ice
passives.description: Your moves freeze your opponents

moves.name: Freeze - Control M1
moves.description: Swing down, leaving a trail of ice infront of you, freezing your opponent.

moves.name: Ice Pillar - Control M2
moves.description: Summons a pillar of ice where you stand, freezing any opponents caught in it.

variants.name: Black Wood
variants.description: Emergin Forest deals more damage, however Bark Armor has a slightly shorter duration

variants.name: Birch
variants.description: Emerging Forest and Bark Armor deal more damage and have a longer duration, but both have increased rei costs and cooldowns

variants.name: Pink Ivory
variants.description: Spawns more branches during Emerging Forest but increases the cooldown

variants.name: Mahogony
variants.description: Emerging Forest now costs more reiatsu, but has a shorter cooldown

upgradeEffects.text: Unarmed attacks which hit your armor have a chance to cause opponents to bleed.
Landing hits of "Emerging Forest" cause a brief slowing effect on the opponent.
Armor created by your wood lasts much longer.
This same armor has increased damage reduction.
"Emerging Forest" can hit crumpled opponents.
"Emerging Forest" spawns more pillars of wood.

moves.name: Emerging Forest - Control M1
moves.description: Launches 6 auto-tracking roots at your enemy.

moves.name: Bark Armor - Control M2
moves.description: Involves the user in a wood armor, granting a 15% damage reduction for 18s

upgradeEffects.text: Enemies can't block or parry your attacks from the front while in 'Reversal'
Apply 'Reversal' momentarily on rushdown. (non-manual, non-z step)
Apply 'Reversal' after successfully landing a manual rushdown. (FORM ONLY)
Apply 'Reversal' to countered opponents.
'Self Mirror' has 2 charges.

passives.name: Reversal
passives.description: Your moves apply the 'Reversal' state, while affected by it, opponens have their screens turned upside down, and have their controls changed and inverted.

moves.name: Self Mirror - Control M1
moves.description: Summon a clone which mimicks your movement, moving inverted horizontaly. If an opponent hits your clone, they are affected by the 'Reversal' effect

moves.name: Inverted World - Control M2
moves.description: Launch forward a small mist which inflicts the 'Reversal' state onto enemies hit by it

upgradeEffects.text: Chaining your M1 casts very quickly will ramp the damage.
Landing your m1 casts will slightly refund some of the reiatsu spent
Your Parry/Block radius increases to 360 while in mode
Perfect parries refund more posture at all times
"Holy Wailing" will hit crumpled opponents
You can do the final "Hunting Dash" recast without being in mode

moves.name: Hunting Dash (Base) - Control M1
moves.description: Dash forward, this move has a variant if you M1 during it.

moves.name: Hunting Dash (Recast) - Control M1
moves.description: Recasting while running will make you do 2 slashes

passives.name: Weapon
passives.description: Mantis mode will change your weapon to a 4 armed style, which uses your weapon module.

moves.name: Hunting Dash (Mode) - Control M1
moves.description: Same as base, but you have an extra recast window after the 2 slashes, which do an uppercut and slams down your opponent on the last one.

moves.name: Holy Wailing - M2
moves.description: Slash twice before releasing a torrent of slashes

upgradeEffects.text: You can use your right gun to split a left gun projectile into 3 smaller projectiles. This will take half a charge.
Killing someone with your 'Right Gun' will disintegrate them.
Using 'light attack' after landing a successful air launcher will snipe them out of the air.

passives.name: Overheat
passives.description: You are given an Overheat bar that holds up to 30 'Charges', which fills up by M1s, using left gun or right gun. If a move is used while overheat is full, you'll change stances automatically and play a reloading animation. You can also hold M3 (MMB) to switch stances, emptying the overheat bar.

passives.name: Weapon
passives.description: Your weapon is replaced by Reishi Guns (Matches your reiatsu color). The m1s fill 1.5 bars of overheat each, while the crit fills 3

moves.name: Left Gun - Control M1
moves.description: While in left gun style, pressing control m1 will shoot an auto tracking ball, which spends 1 of your three left gun charges while also filling 5 overheat charges

moves.name: Right Gun - Control M1
moves.description: While in right gun style, pressing control m1 will shoot a powerful cero-like blast, spending 1 of your right gun charge and filling 14 of the overheat bars.

passives.name: Overheat
