passives.name: Weapon
passives.description: Your weapon is replaced by Reishi Guns (Matches your reiatsu color). The first m1 will fill 3 bars of overheat, all subsequent ones will fill 4. Your critical fills 7 bars

moves.name: Soul Partition - Control M2
moves.description: Pressing Control M2 will summon 3 wolves behind you, giving you access to your ability other moves.

moves.name: Call Of The Wind - Control M1
moves.description: Pressing conntrol M1 while in soul partition will make a wolf jump to the closes enemy to your cursor (has a short activation range). If this is your last remaining wolf, you will exit out of the soul partition state and go back to your base moves.

moves.name: Calmilla - Control M2
moves.description: Pressing control m2 while in soul partition will send out multiple slashes, dealing moderate damage. If you have any remaining wolves they will jump at the end of the move, dealing extra damage. This moves takes you out of the soul partition state.

moves.name: Cero Metralleta - Control M2
moves.description: After hitting enough hits(with your guns out) in mode, a wolf howl sound will play, replacing your m2 with the cero metralleta. This move can only be used once per pop

variants.name: Gamma
variants.description: You now gain damage reduction based off AP, landing "Berserker Slam" will automatically give you AP, but the damage of "Berserker Slam" and "Berserker Combo" is reduced.

variants.name: Shifter
variants.description: You gain extra health regeneration at max AP and "Onslaught" and "Berserker Combo" gain increased movement speed. "Onslaught" also gets less windup, and less damage.

upgradeEffects.text: Your increased size grants you defense.
You gain more size from more AP.
Gain special executions against low health enemies with "Berserker Slam" and "Onslaught".
Your increased size grants you offense.
Your recast after "Berserker Slam" has more forgiving timing.
"Berserker Slam" and "Onslaught" ignore ragdoll and crumple states.

passives.name: Size Increase
passives.description: You gain more size the more AP you have

moves.name: Berserker Slam (Base) - Control M1
moves.description: Move forward and do a strong punch on the ground, this move has a second part if you m1 as soon as you hit the ground.

moves.name: Berserker Slam (2nd Part) - Control M1
moves.description: Pressing M1 as soon as you punch the ground will make you throw a barrage of punches at your opponent.

moves.name: Onslaught - Control M2
moves.description: Run forward, grabbing the first enemy you come in contact with, jumping and slaming him onto the ground (Crumples)

variants.name: Blood In The Water
variants.description: All shark-related attacks are more damaging, however have increased cooldowns and reiatsu costs. Cosmetics: Changes water to be blood red. Also changes move colors to red.

upgradeEffects.text: Deal 1.2x damage to 'Wet' enemies.
Shark moves will eat the opponents reiatsu.
Standing on puddles will increase reiatsu regeneration rate.
Your sharks inflict bleed.

passives.name: Wet
passives.description: Slows down opponents movement speed

moves.name: Graceful Dive - Control M1
moves.description: Dive into the ground, hitting for miniscule damage and leaving behind 3 puddles, before moving underground. After a few seconds (or on recast), you jump out with a slash, ragdolling enemies into the air and spawning 3 more puddles.

moves.name: Shark Bomb (Aerial) - Control M2
moves.description: While in 'Graceful Dive', pressing Control M2 will make you jump out from below,summoning a shark in front of you which slams down your opponent

moves.name: Tide Sever - Control M2 (Close Range)
moves.description: Pressing Control M2 while close to an opponent will make you dash forward, slashing the opponent with water and spawning 2 puddles.

moves.name: Shark Bomb - Control M2 (Long Range)
moves.description: While in mode, your control m2 at long range will summon a shark, which dashes toward your cursor. Applies the wet effect for 4s, also spawns puddles on use and on hit,

variants.name: Elastic
variants.description: "Scales of Fury" will pull opponents back in after flinging them away, at the cost of the move being less powerful.

upgradeEffects.text: Gain 'Empowered' after successfully landing "Scale of Fury" for 6 seconds.
'Scale of Fury' gains lifesteal while form is active.
All bleed damage will heal you slightly (1% per 20 bleed damage)
Gain access to "Ritual" while being Empowered.

moves.name: Scale Of Fury - Control M1
moves.description: Dash forward grabing your opponent, throwing them away after (Rushdown window).

passives.name: Empowered
passives.description: While empowered, all your m1s proc bleed, also allows the use of 'Ritual'. Rushdowns from rushdown windows also proc bleed while empowered.

moves.name: Empower - Control M2
moves.description: Stab your self, dealing about a bar of damage (Iframes), then start healing right after. The healing increases based on your missing hp. This move also gives you the 'Empowered' effect for 24s

moves.name: Ritual - Control M2
moves.description: While empowered, your m2 changes to 'Ritual'. Ritual is a move that heals you based on the amount of people you procced bleed on (by m1ing other people while empowered). The move also gives you TRUE dmg resistence for 9s after it ends.

upgradeEffects.text: Electro skills cause the lightning status effect.
Discharge tracks the nearest enemy.
Lightning is always active on your weapon (effect unknown).
Your parries have lightning properties (effect unknown).
God blaster is rushdown-compatible.

moves.name: Discharge - Control M1
moves.description: Send forward an orb which shoots 4 times at close enemies.

moves.name: God Blaster - Control M2
moves.description: Leap into the air and throw a focused ball of electricity at your cursor.

variants.name: Energy
variants.description: Less damage but gain reiatsu on hit. Also changes color to Blue.

variants.name: Ultraviolet
variants.description: Attacks have fire properties on hit. Also changes color to Pink.

upgradeEffects.text: Fire an additional shot on your "Finger Shot." For every 2 more points in this stat, shoot an additional shot, up to 3.
"Light Kick" now ragdolls and knock up.
After landing any "Luminosity" ability, create light orbs that circle you, each orb will pop when dealing melee damage.
Create more orbs, and they last longer.

moves.name: Finger Shot - Control M1
moves.description: Shoot a beam of light from your finger.

moves.name: Light Kick - Control M2
moves.description: Release a burst of energy before swiftly kicking your opponent.

variants.name: Cursed
variants.description: "Lurk" deals much more damage, however its status debuff is less effective. Also changes color to green.

variants.name: Rewritten
variants.description: "Haze" Will also cause victims to forget their names; temporarily weakening them. However, the overall duration of effects is lowered. Also changes color to white.

upgradeEffects.text: Using "Haze" will add skill-disabling properties to your weapon.
Using "Haze" will allow your basic attacks to disable skills.
Your mist will disable shunpo/flashsteps.
Your mist will lower opponents' damage output by 10%.

passives.name: Haze Effect
passives.description: Your moves apply the 'Haze' effect to your enemy, removing their ability to use skills.

moves.name: Haze - Control M1
moves.description: Summon a cloud around will, applying haze on any opponent hit for 5s

moves.name: Lurk - Control M2
moves.description: Delve into a sea of mist, rushing forward and hitting anyone in your way, applying haze for 5s

clans.name: Le Vaar
buffs: Be able to proc poison damage upon dealing heavy amounts of damage, flourishing and guardbreaking enemies
Your traversal sprint is now 15% faster and has a new animation

clans.name: Lloyd
buffs: Gain access to all Sensory passives free of cost

clans.name: Kurotsuchi
buffs: Spirit charm overflow takes less health (4%)

clans.name: Kurosaki
buffs: Gain access to all Sensory passives free of cost

clans.name: Urahara
buffs: You now get a 20% bigger window for perfect casting SR kido abilities

clans.name: Tosen
buffs: Be able to see enemies during their Shunpo using sense

clans.name: Aaroniero
buffs: Changes your head into a jar

clans.name: Chelute
buffs: Changes your head into a skull

clans.name: Kurosaki
buffs: Gain access to all Sensory passives free of cost

clans.name: Starrk
buffs: Your cero now fires from chest instead of your head

traits.name: Tentacles
buffs: 16% chance to inflict poison damage on melee attacks

traits.name: Energized
buffs: Weapon (not fist) damage slightly scales off your kido stat

song-of-fire-and-thunder.name: Song of Fire and Thunder
song-of-fire-and-thunder.description: When above {{melee_ap}} AP, your melee attacks are imbued in flame, dealing more damage. If below 25% max hp, your high-damaging melee attacks have a chance to inflict scorch (10s CD)When above {{kido_ap}} AP, your kido attacks are inflict thunder, dealing more stun. If below 25% max hp, your high-damaging kido attacks have a chance to inflict electroshock ({{kido_cd}}s CD)

aura-of-terror.name: Aura Of Terror
aura-of-terror.description: Manual spiritual pressure is replaced with an AOE attack that inflicts a terrifying status effect on enemies hit and deal {{hp_dmg}} max HP damage ({{cd}}s CD)

adrenaline-junkie.name: Adrenaline Junkie
adrenaline-junkie.description:
Gain 1% output on hit up to 107% (not including multi hit techniques). If you do not get hit/hit an enemy for 30 seconds, automatically return to 100%.
 Lose 1% output when getting hit, down to 10%

await-the-opening.name: Await The Opening
await-the-opening.description:
Your parries now posture break.
 Your parries are worth {{parry_dmg}} as much posture damage

blazing-spirit.name: Blazing Spirit
blazing-spirit.description:
Parrying a basic melee attack ignites your blade with spirit flames ({{cd}}s CD, +{{dmg_buff}} damage)
 Basic Melee attacks not ignited by flame deal reduced damage (-{{dmg_debuff}}% damage)

blademaster.name: Blademaster
blademaster.description: Your bladed basic attacks inflict deep gash stacks on your opponent. Your bladed basic attacks deal {{dmg_reduction}} less damage. Upon reaching {{deep_gash_amount}} deep gash stacks, deal {{deep_gash_dmg}}% of all the damage you would have done normally.

curtain-call.name: Curtain Call
curtain-call.description:
As long as your reiatsu is at {{rei_amount}}, your basic attacks have percent lifesteal 
 You no longer passively regenerate reiatsu

flawless-swordsman.name: Flawless Swordsman
flawless-swordsman.description:
Dealing damage without being hit will build 'Perfection', whilst Perfection is building gain up to a {{dmg_buff}} damage buff towards enemies, at half stacks or more all damage is fire damage.
Suffering a hit or leaving combat will extinguish your flame of ambition, losing all stacks. Leaving a cooldown of 10s before your next attempt.

haze-of-death.name: Haze of Death
haze-of-death.description: Your critical attack applies Cursed ({{cd}}s CD)

heavenly-restriction.name: Heavenly Restriction
heavenly-restriction.description:
Your physical attacks are up to {{dmg_buff}} more potent, scaling with level
 You have {{aura_gain}} more aura gain, scaling with level
 You gain {{max_ap}} more max AP and {{shunpo_buff}} more shunpo speed and stamina. You gain up to {{move_speed}} more movement speed
 You slightly gain melee defense and kido defense
 Your aura is on a shorter cooldown and you gain more output in aura
 Your critical attacks now auto-execute. You do more damage towards riposte and you cannot be sensed
 You cannot use abilities to any capacity
 (Does not fully stack with Warrior's Spirit)

kill-confirmed.name: Kill Confirmed
kill-confirmed.description:
Knocking an opponent will cause them to succumb to your spiritual pressure and cause their head to blow off 
Blowing their head off will reduce your output by {{debuff}} (Scaling with nearby enemies) temporarily

last-man-standing.name: Last Man Standing
last-man-standing.description:
If an ally is to be knocked within 90 meters of you, siphon the enemies HP pack and gain a percent of it yourself 
Your regeneration from all sources is cut in half

monster-slayer.name: Monster Slayer
monster-slayer.description:
For every nearby NPC enemy gain a stack of 'Slayer', up to 10 stacks 
 For every stack of 'Slayer' gain {{monster_dmg}}% more Monster Damage, increasing up to 3.5 times 
 While you have 'Slayer' stacks: at 3 stacks gain weaker Curtain Call, at 4 stacks become immune to movement slow, and at 6 stacks your Curtain Call strengthens 
 When you're put in combat by a player, all 'Slayer' stacks are rendered invalid

quick-grit.name: Quick Grit
quick-grit.description: Landing 3 different non-barrage attacks on the same person within {{window}}s smites the opponent, granting a {{dmg_buff}} damage buff on the most recent attack ({{cooldown}}s CD)

raid-boss.name: Raid Boss
raid-boss.description:
Your aura cooldown is shortened
 For every nearby PLAYER enemy gain a stack of battle fever, for every nearby PLAYER ally lose a stack of battle fever, up to 10 stacks
 For every stack of battle fever gain {{aura_buildup}} more aura buildup. While your Aura is active, this instead boosts your Spiritual Pressure's power level, both increasing up to 3.5 times
 While your Aura is active: at 3 stacks gain weaker Curtain Call, at 4 stacks become immune to movement slow, at 6 stacks your Curtain Call strengthens, finally at 7 stacks your m1s periodically proc Perfect Flash
 When your battle fever is empty and allies are nearby take 10% more damage

rulers-gaze.name: Ruler's Gaze
rulers-gaze.description:
Performing a guard break activates "Geass".
Whilst "Geass" is active, issue a command to the opponent to halt, allowing for a longer follow up. "Geass" cannot be used on the same target twice, and has a cooldown. Being in "Aura" ignores the first restriction.

shonen-syndrome.name: Shonen Syndrome
shonen-syndrome.description:
Yell out the move you are about to use 
 Upgrades the move by {{levels}} levels (Does not work past level 6)
 {{cd}} second cooldown between upgrades

strugglers-spirit.name: Struggler's Spirit
strugglers-spirit.description:
Landing three basic attacks when below {{hp_percent}} HP will balster your strength ({{cd}}s CD)
 You take {{dmg_reduction}} less damage when your health is below 25%

soul-snatcher.name: Soul Snatcher
soul-snatcher.description:
Landing any kido ability on a opponent who is less than {{hp_percent}} HP will activate Soul Snatcher
 Enemies with Soul Snatcher activated on them will immediately be knocked after a short delay

the-incapable.name: The Incapable
the-incapable.description:
Your innate base output is up to {{base}} depending on level, this goes up to {{max_base}} based on missing HP
 Gain access to a reliquary attached to your waist, this is the source of your power. It glows based on missing HP
 You can no longer use transformations or racial abilities, and effects of hollow traits are disabled
 You can not access your racial progression boss fights

undying-soul.name: Undying Soul
undying-soul.description:
Unleash a second wind when defeated, become ungrabbable in this state
 Your death is certain when your health runs out

ultimate-sacrifice.name: Ultimate Sacrifice
ultimate-sacrifice.description:
Break your current limits and go beyond when popping Aura 
 Your rage is born from deep within your heart. Nothing can stop it (Uncancellable Aura)
 You build aura more slowly. The ultimate sacrifice... has the ultimate price

warriors-spirit.name: Warrior's Spirit
warriors-spirit.description:
{{dmg_buff}} melee damage increase on basic attacks
 You can no longer Flash Step nor Manual Rushdown

youre-in-my-range.name: You're In My Range
youre-in-my-range.description:
{{gap_defense}} defense towards gap-close abilities
 Your next basic attack or critical is empowered after being attacked by a gap-close ability (45s CD)

jack-o-lantern.name: Jack-o-Lantern
jack-o-lantern.description:
Maiming a player forces them to wear a pumpkin head. The pumpkin head remains for 1 minute until it explode. For each kill, you gain a jack-o'-lantern (max 3) that hovers behind you. When taking a lethal blow you consume a jack-o'-lantern and heal.
 You now grip players 2.5x slower
 You now maim enemies 1.25x slower

backline-buster.name: Backline Buster
backline-buster.description: Hitting an opponent then hitting a different opponent shortly after procs Perfect Flash ({{cd}}s CD)

no-time-to-spare.name: No Time To Spare
no-time-to-spare.description: Once put into combat, gain the effecs of light feet until you are hit.

deep-hatred.name: Deep Hatred
deep-hatred.description: When posture broken or grabbed, enter a fit of rage for {{duration}}s, boosting your output by 10% (30s CD)

factotums-spirit.name: Factotum's Spirit
factotums-spirit.description:
{{xp_gain}} increased EXP gain
 {{xp_loss}} increased EXP loss

frostwalker.name: Frostwalker
frostwalker.description:
Dealing a high-damage kido blow will embue you in frost, this effect lasts {{frost_duration}}s or until consumed
 While frosted your next basic attack will freeze your opponent (25s CD) 
 While frosted, lose {{speed_debuff}} movespeed

frugal.name: Frugal
frugal.description:
You lose 80% less cash from dying to players
 You don't gain cash from players

golem.name: Golem
golem.description:
Taking {{dmg_amount}}+ base damage withing 2.5s will activate rock armor for {{duration}}s (45s CD)
 While rock-armored, gain {{dmg_resist}} damage resistence

heat-burst.name: Heat Burst
heat-burst.description:
Replaces your Aura with Heat
 When Heat activates, automatically heal {{heal}} of your maximum health and gain max AP
 Lose access to Aura-based theme buff

indomitable-spirit.name: Indomitable Spirit
indomitable-spirit.description:
Gain {{hp}} of your health back from winning clashes
 Lose {{hp_loss}} of your health upon losing clashes

lizards-spirit.name: Lizard's Spirit
lizards-spirit.description: When your health reaches below {{hp_amount}}, heal {{heal}} (9m CD)

marshland-king.name: Marshland King
marshland-king.description:
Build aura {{buildup}} faster, and unleash a menacing laugh when popping it
 Your aura is {{duration}} shorter and the buffs are {{aura_nerf}} weaker

merchants-blessing.name: Merchant's Blessing
merchants-blessing.description: Gain {{token_gain}} more soul tokens from all gameplay sources

mysterious-stranger-her.name: Mysterious Stranger (Her)
mysterious-stranger-her.description: The mysterious stranger has a {{chance}} chance to aid you when dealing ranged kido damage (30s CD)

mysterious-stranger-him.name: Mysterious Stranger (Him)
mysterious-stranger-him.description: The mysterious stranger has a {{chance}} chance to aid you when dealing physical damage (30s CD)

nowhere-to-hide.name: Nowhere to Hide
nowhere-to-hide.description:
Striking an opponent below {{player_hp}} HP while you are above 50% HP will cause them to be revealed for 5s 
 Deal {{dmg_buff}} more damage to those who are revealed

overtime-hours.name: Overtime Hours
overtime-hours.description:
During a mission, if the clock runs down below 75% of the starting time you start running off overtime 
 During overtime, gain 6.5% output and continue to gain it for every invader that joins

perfect-flash.name: Perfect Flash
perfect-flash.description: Landing a melee Basic/Critical attack out of combat deals {{dmg_buff}} dmg, this also applies to full-hp opponents (60s CD)

presence-of-mind.name: Presence of Mind
presence-of-mind.description: You have an increased {{haste}} ability haste when below {{hp_amount}}% of your maximum HP

reality-warper.name: Reality Warper
reality-warper.description: 5% chance to spawn a purple portal on player kill

side-character.name: Side Character
side-character.description:
Deal {{dmg_buff}}% more damage to NPCs 
 Take {{dmg_taken}} more damage from players

silent-shadows.name: Silent Shadows
silent-shadows.description: Your visible aura is reduced by 60%

superiority-complex.name: Superiority Complex
superiority-complex.description:
Blade-catching an opponent will cause you to mock them, increasing aura gain on the blade catch ({{cd}}s CD)
 Mocked opponents instantly lose 0.2x AP and take 15% increased damage for a short duration

surgeons-spirit.name: Surgeon's Spirit
surgeons-spirit.description:
All heals towards you are increased by {{heal_buff}} 
 You no longer receive HP packs from knocking players

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.description: Landing your critical attack will spawn {{spawn_amount}} friendly Dragonfly Hollow

train-conductor.name: Train Conductor
train-conductor.description:
Steal a mission ticket when killing an enemy player who has one
 Mission ticket cap increased by one
 Dying will cause you to lose 2 mission tickets

tools-of-the-trade.name: Tools of the Trade
tools-of-the-trade.description: You have absolute mastery over your weaponry, your heavy attack is never red, gain riposte on the attack anyway (Does not work for heavy attacks that are never red to begin with)

tooth-and-nail.name: Tooth & Nail
tooth-and-nail.description: If an attack is about to kill you, lose all of your health down to {{health_back}} instead of dying

vice-it.name: Vice It
vice-it.description: Blade-catching the opponent won't restore posture, however you kick the enemy away (75s CD)

wraiths-spirit.name: Wraith's Spirit
wraiths-spirit.description:
Getting hit by {{hit_amount}} different attacks in quick succession will cause you to turn into a invincible wraith momentarily
 You take {{melee_damage}} more damage from melee attacks

draculas-fangs.name: Dracula's Fangs
draculas-fangs.description:
Grips now give you {{grip_heal}} more hp back
 When dealing heavy damage or using your crit you have a 50% chance to proc bleed damage
 This will turn you into a.. VAMPIRE!!

dead-man-walking.name: Dead Man Walking
dead-man-walking.description:
Taking heavy amounts of damage within a short timeframe will now cause you to lose skin.. slowly turning you into a skeleton.
 For each limb lost, take {{dmg_debuff}} more damage, but also gain {{move_speed}} movement speed, up to five limbs lost. ({{cd}}s CD)

witches-brew.name: Witches Brew
witches-brew.description:
Popping aura now makes you consume a potion of poison allowing you to proc poison on all attacks when in aura.
 Aura gain is increased by {{aura_gain}}

at-the-ready.name: At the Ready
at-the-ready.description: Gain permanent {{haste_buff}} ability haste when invaded

battle-hardened.name: Battle Hardened
battle-hardened.description: You visually bleed on hits at lower health

defensive-regen.name: Defensive Regen
defensive-regen.description:
You regenerate {{rei_regen}} more reiatsu from parries
 Your base reiatsu regeneration is reduced by {{base_regen}}

giant-fighter.name: Giant Fighter
giant-fighter.description:
{{dmg_buff}} more damage against Bosses
 2.5% less damage against non-boss NPCs

head-hunter.name: Head Hunter
head-hunter.description: Deal {{dmg_buff}} more damage towards players with active transformation/shikai if you have neither

prey-turned-predator.name: Prey Turned Predator
prey-turned-predator.description: If someone invades you while you are on a mission, they get combat logged

resourceful-spirit.name: Resourceful Spirit
resourceful-spirit.description: Your aerial launcher is counted as a critical attack, dealing slightly more damage and applying all critical attack effects

trouble-in-paradise.name: Trouble in Paradise
trouble-in-paradise.description: Deal 10% more damage when fighting in a Homeworld

hakudaBasics.name: Hakuda Basics
hakudaBasics.flavorText: Gain the ability to fight with your fists.

ironGuard.name: Iron Guard
ironGuard.flavorText: You no longer take chip damage from blocking.

sideSwitcher.name: Side Switcher
sideSwitcher.flavorText: Switching between hakuda and your primary weapon is much faster, upgrading this will increase the speed

surgeFist.name: Surge Fist
surgeFist.flavorText: Concentrate your reiatsu into a small pressurized blast projectile and release it.

upgradeEffects.text: Unlock an air variant of Surge Fist when holding jump while casting the ability. 35% faster, however only aimed in a set direction
Air variant hits crumpled opponents

reiatsuBlasts.name: Reiatsu Blasts
reiatsuBlasts.flavorText: Summon 3 homing blasts of reiatsu from the ground

upgradeEffects.text: Summon an extra projectile
Landing all 3 kicks will apply Concussion on the third kick.

hakudaKai.name: Hakuda Kai
hakudaKai.flavorText: Every 3rd basic attack deals bonus Kido scaling damage (This scales with your KIDO stat, not kido dmg %).

blastPunisher.name: Blast Punisher
blastPunisher.flavorText: Shoot energy blasts from your hands. Lock onto an enemy if hit.

dragonFist.name: Dragon Fist
dragonFist.flavorText: Perform a reiatsu-infused uppercut that ragdolls the opponent on the second hit.

upgradeEffects.text: Gain Super Armor during the end-lag of the attack.
Perform Demon Flash during the 2nd hit of the attack.
Demon Flash can execute

godFist.name: God Fist
godFist.flavorText:
Pressing Light Attack, Heavy Attack, Counter, Parry or Dash will let you perform different attacks.

Use Shunpo to flashstep and teleport behind your enemy.

Mixing up and using different attacks will slowly ramp up damage. God Fist can be used at any point of your Ultimate Bar, with more longer combos being available with more bar

upgradeEffects.text: God Fist can now auto-execute

dragonLash.name: Dragonlash
dragonLash.flavorText: A mid range, high-stun aerial kick.

hardPressure.name: Hard Pressure
hardPressure.flavorText: Landing a blunt attack off a flash step will increase the potsure damage.

dustKick.name: Dust Kick
dustKick.flavorText: Cloud your opponent's vision, landing this attack at close range will deal the damage of your kick itself.

upgradeEffects.text: Dust Kick ignores ragdoll.

boxerFootwork.name: Boxer's Footwork
boxerFootwork.flavorText: Enter a state in which you dodge attacks instead of parrying for 12s after perfect parrying 3 times in quick succession, with no neutral parries. Dodges have 35% increased posture loss vs parries.

dropKick.name: Drop Kick
dropKick.flavorText: Lunge forwards dealing light posture damage.

upgradeEffects.text: Drop Kick is fully rotatable.
Apply concussion on landed hits.

breakerFist.name: Breaker Fist
breakerFist.flavorText: Rupture the ground, then cause it to burst which transfers up to 25% of your posture (scales with upgrades) to yor opponent if landed.

upgradeEffects.text: The second strike of Breaker Fist hits ragdolled/crumpled opponents

shoulderThrow.name: Shoulder Throw
shoulderThrow.flavorText: Pressing Counter while near a opponent who is posture broken will cause you to flip them over your shoulder, ragdolling them. This also replaces your default Red Counter. (30s CD)

fighterTempo.name: Fighter's Tempo
fighterTempo.flavorText: Strike a pose, reducing your posture and making all of your melee attacks reduce your posture.

upgradeEffects.text: Pressing Counter during your startup now unleashes a punch that scales off your posture
Fighter's Tempo becomes uncancellable.

sweepKick.name: Sweep Kick
sweepKick.flavorText: Sweep kick which stuns the target in place.

tempestCombo.name: Tempest Combo
tempestCombo.flavorText: Enter a state of ferocity and unleash a barrage of strong left and rights. Once hit, the enemy cannot escape.

groundSlam.name: Ground Slam
groundSlam.flavorText: An aerial slam attack. Gain bonus damage based on landing heigh, ignores crumple.

upgradeEffects.text: Your max height multiplier is changed from 1.2x -> 1.3x

spiritBreaker.name: Spirit Breaker
spiritBreaker.flavorText: Pressing Counter while facing an wallbanged enemy will grab them and slam them into the ground.

upgradeEffects.text: Apply concussion to enemies

spiritBreakerCannon.name: Spirit Breaking Cannon
spiritBreakerCannon.flavorText: Grab your opponent then drag them through the floor, if you meet a wall, perform a 2nd attack combo, failing to meet a wall allows an alternate combo route. Unblockable.

upgradeEffects.text: You can now Manual Rushdown to an enemy during the startup of Spirit Breaking Cannon

aerialFlip.name: Aerial Flip
aerialFlip.flavorText: Flip towards an airbone opponent, grab them out of the air and slam them to the ground with you.

upgradeEffects.text: Apply concussion prone to enemies.
Aerial flip is now unblockable.

flashKick.name: Flash Kick
flashKick.flavorText: Spin around and launch your opponent into the air with a powerful kick.

punisherDrive.name: Punisher Drive
punisherDrive.flavorText: Think you can keep up? After a short startup turn briefly invisible and barrage your opponent with a flurry of attacks.

flashStrike.name: Flash Strike
flashStrike.flavorText: Focus and warp your enemies perception of you, then teleport to them and deliver a strong kick.

upgradeEffects.text: You can now feint Flash Strike by pressing Counter during the startup, teleport in front of them by using shunpo after feinting
Deal additional damage/posture damage when used right up close.

blur.name: Blur
blur.flavorText: Dealing basic hakuda damage will refill your shunpo stamina.

fightBack.name: Fight Back
fightBack.flavorText: Landing 3 consecutive attacks will empower your 4th

flashCounter.name: Flash Counter
flashCounter.flavorText: Enter a counter pose where you negate all incoming melee damage and retaliate with a spinning kick.

upgradeEffects.text: Flash Counter can now concuss opponents
Flash Counter cannot be blocked and must be parried

incinerator.name: Incinerator
incinerator.flavorText: Do a rushing knee, on contact connect into a barrage of flaming kicks.

upgradeEffects.text: Perform a flip instead of the traditional spinning kicks, increasing air time.
Scorch your opponents on the final hit, causing tick damage.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.flavorText: Temporarily gain a 20% output boost after executing someone.

suplex.name: Bone Breaker
suplex.flavorText: A continuous barrage that consists of five hits

upgradeEffects.text: Pressing Counter will allow for heavy punch, cancelling the barrage.

theUnderdog.name: The Underdog
theUnderdog.flavorText: If there is a 30% HP gap between you and your opponent, your next basic attack deals +5 enemy health percent bonus damage (25s CD)

swingingThrow.name: Swinging Throw
swingingThrow.flavorText: Grab your opponent by the waist and violently swing them around, then throw them at full force to finish.

upgradeEffects.text: Landing the grab on the first frame will cause your throw to do an additional 2% enemy max hp dmg, signified by blue sparks.
You can pick up ragdolled opponents

deathFist.name: Death Fist
deathFist.flavorText: Secret technique of Death Kwon Do

upgradeEffects.text: Refreshes Elbow Drop cooldown on-hit
Gain riposte frames on startup
Landing the move on an enemy with low health will auto execute them.

muscleUp.name: Muscle Up
muscleUp.flavorText: Flex your muscle and gain 90% damage reduction. If you take more than 10 of pre-mitigation damage you gain an HP pack relative to damage taken, reduces 10% of posture.

grapplerGambit.name: Elbow Drop
grapplerGambit.flavorText:
Perform an elbow drop, following up with a running hook, holding Space during the move launches you further. Damages crumpled and ragdolled opponents, pressing Counter while running to stop, feinting near the end of the run will give you the EMPOWERED effect.
-Empowered gives:
-Death fist gains extra dmg and posture dmg, takes you further
-Bone breaker grants a zstep window
-If level 3: Jaguar rush becomes old suplex,Swinging throw gains kanji.

upgradeEffects.text: Perfect casting (feinting at the end of the move) will now buff Jaguar Rush and Swinging Throw
Elbow Drop can now auto execute knocked and low health enemies

jaguarRush.name: Jaguar Rush
jaguarRush.flavorText: Enter a sprint stance, once your dash is completed if nearby an opponent, attempt a RKO. Whiffing the RKO gives you Empowered.

upgradeEffects.text: Pressing Counter during the run will now let you perform a drop kick, which also gives you Empowered.
Concusses enemies

heavyKick.name: Heavy Kick
heavyKick.flavorText: Kick the target away, inflicting decent posture damage.

upgradeEffects.text: Apply concussion prone to enemies

thrust.name: Thrust
thrust.flavorText: Lunge forwards dealing light posture damage, the speed you travel increases with time.

upgradeEffects.text: Your thrust is rotatable during startup
Tenran sucks people in when blocked
Tenran will now always suck people in

meleeKidoSpecialist.name: Melee Kido Specialist
meleeKidoSpecialist.flavorText: Landing a basic attack shortly before using a kido move will buff its damage

kineticForce.name: Kinetic Force
kineticForce.flavorText: Strike a pose, in which you gather reiatsu, and activate kido-enhancement for your next basic attack.

upgradeEffects.text: Gain extra reiatsu on completed cast
Gain enhanced reiatsu regeneration for 2.5s after completed cast
Recasting Kinetic Force very quickly after a completed pose will slice out 2 energy slashes
Gain a longer window to recast into the energy slashes and change skill's color to your reiatsu color

rendingTide.name: Rending Tide
rendingTide.flavorText: Unleash a tide of slashes that surges forward. Enemies caught in it are carried along and thrown out when the tide breaks.

upgradeEffects.text: The tide can hit wallbanged enemies, and stops on them instead of passing through the wall

bloodTax.name: Blood Tax
bloodTax.flavorText: Strengthen a powerful slash with impressive range using your own blood, does not require full ultimate bar. If cast with full ultimate bar, perform a 2nd equally devastating slash.

upgradeEffects.text: Landing the move on an enemy with low health will auto execute them.
Hitting someone with the edge of the slash will deal more damage and cause bleed (1.2x dmg).
You can dash during the startup of Cyclone
You can now feint the slash

fellCrescent.name: Fell Crescent
fellCrescent.flavorText: Leap backwards and attack your previous position.

upgradeEffects.text: Gain riposte frames on startup
Execute low health enemies

keroseneSlam.name: Kerosene Slam
keroseneSlam.flavorText: Send two false afterimages to fool an opponent, then leap towards them and slam down with all your might, concussing enemies on impact. The further the leap, the harder the slam hits (ignores crumple).

upgradeEffects.text: "Kerosene Slam" autoexecutes

oneMind.name: One Mind
oneMind.flavorText: A onslaught of relentless slashes, with a powerful strike at the end

upgradeEffects.text: Gain riposte frames in One Mind

overwhelmingStrength.name: Overwhelming Strength
overwhelmingStrength.flavorText: Guardbreaking an opponent will wound them. While wounded, their posture damage taken is increased significantly

overheadStrike.name: Overhead Strike
overheadStrike.flavorText: An overhead strike with poor damage, but extremely high posture damage.

upgradeEffects.text: Overhead Strike now inflicts bleed and you can now feint Overhead Strike by pressing Parry
Overhead Strike restores posture upon use, and also restores posture regardless of it being blocked or parried
Gain hyperarmor for the first 1.05s of startup
Overhead Strike now gains hyperarmor for the duration of the whole move, and it deals 2x posture damage to enemies under 30% health

trainedBody.name: Trained Body
trainedBody.flavorText: Actions that cancel posture regen will reduce the cancellation time

bladeCatch.name: Blade Catch
bladeCatch.flavorText: Your unblockable counter is more posture-effective. Additionally, disrupt the aura of those weaker than you, or those at low HP.

wallSpecialist.name: Wall Specialist
wallSpecialist.flavorText: Pressing Counter while facing an wallbanged enemy will grab them and slam them into the ground.

upgradeEffects.text: Make enemies prone to concussion

piercingDraw.name: Piercing Draw
piercingDraw.flavorText: Use your strength to cause a ripple effect via showckwaves erupting from the ground when you strike it. Can hit ragdolled and crumpled opponents.

upgradeEffects.text: Your super armor from Piercing Draw lingers making it very difficult to whiff-punish
You can rushdown from hit ragdolled opponents

trainedBodyMastery.name: Trained Body Mastery
trainedBodyMastery.flavorText: Deflecting projectiles now reflects them towards the caster

bruteForce.name: Brute Force
bruteForce.flavorText: Guard your body with your blade, reducing all incoming damage by 90%, then reflect all damage back in a spinning hurl

upgradeEffects.text: Your returned damage bypasses riposte frames
Slice off low hp opponents heads if you absorb any damage at all

heavyHitter.name: Heavy Hitter
heavyHitter.flavorText: Hitting someones block reduces your posture slightly

poise.name: Poise
poise.flavorText: Increase penetration through armor and armor-like techniques

skyscrapper.name: Skyscraper
skyscrapper.flavorText: Strong attack that grants hyperarmor, has a lenghty wind-up

upgradeEffects.text: Grain riposte frames on startup
Follow-up attack used by using shunpo after landing the move
The follow-up attack becomes amped on-hit if the opponent is below 40%

impale.name: Impale
impale.flavorText: Impale an opponent and slam them back down to the g round, inflicting bleed

upgradeEffects.text: Impale now gains riposte, and holding Space during the startup now pushes you forward more
Your impale can now automatically execute low HP opponents

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.flavorText: Enter a state of rage caused by anguish when entering low HP. Increases melee damage dealt by 15% - 30% based on missing HP.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.flavorText: Posture executing an enemy can trigger Berserker

guiliotineTrap.name: Guillotine Drop
guiliotineTrap.flavorText: Jump high on the air towards your opponent before attacking them with an impactful slam.

upgradeEffects.text: Guillotine drop no longer ragdolls and now applies bleed.

aerialAce.name: Aerial Ace
aerialAce.flavorText: Counter mid air opponents with a fast shunpo attack.

cloneStrike.name: Clone Strike
cloneStrike.flavorText: Knockback an opponent into an afterimage slash

upgradeEffects.text: Clone strike can hit ragdolled enemies

flashSurprise.name: Flash Surprise
flashSurprise.flavorText: Teleport behind your opponent for a slash attack.

upgradeEffects.text: Gain riposte frames after the initial startup
Knockback on hit and block

kumoKiri.name: Kumo Kiri
kumoKiri.flavorText: Enter a stance where you counter ANY incoming attacks, then perform a kick. If landed, flash step infront of them and do a massive slash

upgradeEffects.text: Countering a ranged attack will skip the kick portion, teleport you infront of them and slash

rapidRecovery.name: Rapid Recovery
rapidRecovery.flavorText: Your reiatsu regeneration speed slightly scales with speed stat

dragonCleaver.name: Dragon Cleaver
dragonCleaver.flavorText: Send a dragon charging forward. If it catches someone it latches on, then you dash in and merge with it, carrying them upward in a flurry of hits before tossing them away.

upgradeEffects.text: The attack becomes supercharged, draining reiatsu on connected hit
Landing the full combo takes Aerial Ace off cooldown, and using it within 2s empowers it with a dragon coiling around you

fireworks.name: Fireworks
fireworks.flavorText: Ignite flammable dust for a blinding attack.

upgradeEffects.text: Fireworks cancels enemy ragdolls, and you can now feint the move
You can now dash during the startup of Fireworks

flyingCyclone.name: Flying Cyclone
flyingCyclone.flavorText: A whirlwind projectile which shreds through enemies in its wake

upgradeEffects.text: You can rushdown to hit enemies when they are launched in the air
Refreshes rushdown cooldown

vortexEdge.name: Vortex Edge
vortexEdge.flavorText: Retreat before flashing forwards with a slash of your weapon.

upgradeEffects.text: Pressing parry during startup will cause you to strike from above, this variant deals slightly less damage.

falseCutter.name: False Cutter
falseCutter.flavorText: Focus your blade forward, leading into a sliding thrust

upgradeEffects.text: Pressing Counter before the thrust will do a high ranged slash, which deals more damage and leads into rushdown options

launcher.name: Launcher
launcher.flavorText: Launch an enemy into the air

upgradeEffects.text: You get a window to slippery fighter off Launcher

reiatsuConservation.name: Reiatsu Conservation
reiatsuConservation.flavorText: Hitting someone directly after a flash step restores 75% of the shunpo bar spent

flashExecute.name: Flash Execute
flashExecute.flavorText: Auto-execute opponents who have low hp or knocked opponents (10% HP or lower)

upgradeEffects.text: Using on a guardbroken opponent has a much higher kill threshold (20%)
Flash execute now has a further range, and slightly higher kill threshold (10% -> 20%, increases level 5 to 25%

lightFeet.name: Light Feet
lightFeet.flavorText: Enter a state in which you dodge attacks instead of parrying for 12s after perfect parrying 3 times in quick succession, with no neutral parries. Dodges have 35% increased posture loss vs parries.

afterimageClones.name: Afterimage Clones
afterimageClones.flavorText: While stunned, use Shunpo to create afterimages around you that let you escape stun;

compoundRush.name: Compound Rush
compoundRush.flavorText: Lunge towards an opponent. If the hit lands, kick off them and fall backwards

upgradeEffects.text: Press Counter after hitting an enemy to do a 2-part attack

bladeFlow.name: Blade Flow
bladeFlow.flavorText: While you were progging Hakuda, I studied the blade. While you were going full-strength, I mastered speed. While you were abusing kido, I cultivated inner strength. Now outskirts is on fire, and you came to me for help?

upgradeEffects.text: Inflict bleed

feintMastery.name: Feint Mastery
feintMastery.flavorText: You can cancel basic attacks by flash stepping

flashSkewer.name: Flash Skewer
flashSkewer.flavorText: Disappear briefly before reappearing to surprise your opponent with a sudden strike.

upgradeEffects.text: Your skewer bypasses riposte frames, and pressing Counter now lets you feint the move
Holding Jump during the move now summons an after image that attacks for you, and automatically feints the move

flashTrick.name: Flash Trick
flashTrick.flavorText: Dashing before flash stepping creates a clone

hyperSpeed.name: Hyperspeed
hyperSpeed.flavorText: Your dash's invincibility frames cooldown is reduced

afterimageSlash.name: Afterimage Slash
afterimageSlash.flavorText: Leave a clone in your place to attack

judgementCut.name: Judgement Cut
judgementCut.flavorText: Flash forward in a straight line before attacking, tracks onto moving enemies

upgradeEffects.text: Judgement Cut can now hit wallbanged players
Landing this move on low HP opponents will dismember their arm

swiftFakeout.name: Swift Fakeout
swiftFakeout.flavorText: Cancelling your Shunpo quickly with a dash will make it take your further, and apply damage reduction for the duration of your dash

whirlwindCutter.name: Whirlwind Cutter
whirlwindCutter.flavorText: Perform three soaring strikes, the third strike teleports you to the nearest opponent

upgradeEffects.text: Gain riposte frames after the first slash and be able to Z-Step if the last hit is landed.
The second slash is true, provided you landed the first one

finalBreath.name: Final Breath
finalBreath.flavorText: Ashes to ashes. Alt fire during the startup to make the final cut launch enemies into the air, dealing less damage but opening a rushdown.

upgradeEffects.text: Auto execute low health opponents in your wake
Landing Final Breath only puts it on a 15 second cooldown, and executing an opponent fully rebuilds your ultimate bar.

agileBody.name: Agile Body
agileBody.flavorText: If you are about to be parry-executed mid battle, avoid their execution and regenerate posture

bala.name: Bala
bala.flavorText: A weaker blast-like counterpart to Cero

upgradeEffects.text: Bala tracks to the nearest opponent

cero.name: Cero
cero.flavorText: Concentrate your reiatsu into a charged beam that eviscerates anyone hit. Executes low hp opponents.

ceroSpeedVariant.name: CeroSpeedVariant
ceroSpeedVariant.flavorText: Reduces startup of cero massively, and slightly reduces its damage

ceroPowerVariant.name: CeroPowerVariant
ceroPowerVariant.flavorText: Increase cero damage and startup time (15% dmg buff)

ceroUltraPowerVariant.name: CeroUltraPowerVariant
ceroUltraPowerVariant.flavorText: Increase cero damage and size MASSIVELY (22.5% dmg buff, replaces power variant buff). Increase startup time and cooldown (20% extra cooldown)

hierro.name: Hierro
hierro.flavorText: An automatic defensive technique that makes the user's skin harder than steel

balaBlaster.name: Bala Blaster
balaBlaster.flavorText: Charge a bala like attack to create an explosion in front of you

balaRipcord.name: Bala Ripcord
balaRipcord.flavorText: Fire a bala infused with reiatsu tethers, if landed onto an opponent directly, yank them towards you using the tethers.

upgradeEffects.text: Bala Ripcord goes through block

deathSaucers.name: Death Saucers
deathSaucers.flavorText: Condense your bala into a 2 sharp, tracking saucers and send them flying

upgradeEffects.text: Landing the move on an enemy with low health will slice them in half

fingerCero.name: Finger Cero
fingerCero.flavorText: A faster laser-like version of Cero that comes from your finger

upgradeEffects.text: You can rushdown off Finger Cero
You can now Cero Absorption off Finger Cero

unpredictableCero.name: Unpredictable Cero
unpredictableCero.flavorText: Press Counter while charging cero to delay it by 0.75s, at the cost of lowering damage

ceroRapidFire.name: CeroRapidFire
ceroRapidFire.flavorText: Your cero can now be fired in bursts of 3. However, the damage is reduced appropriately

upgradeEffects.text: Gain Cero-Enhancement on your blade when landing Hollow Cutter
Press Counter during startup to unleash "Extinction", a colossal reishi slash that deals 13% less damage. Disables Cero Absorption
"Extinction" disintegrates

ceroArmor.name: Cero Armor
ceroArmor.flavorText: Using cero while hierro is active allows you to absorb an extra hit before your cero ins cancelled

ceroAbsorption.name: Cero Absorption
ceroAbsorption.flavorText: Pressing Parry before your cero fires will cancel it and absorb its energy into your weapon, granting you enhanced damage for 3 swings

zeroClutch.name: Zero Clutch
zeroClutch.flavorText: Grab your opponent by the neck, choke them, then finish with a finger cero to the dome

upgradeEffects.text: Zero Clutch autoexecutes at low hp

psychoCrash.name: Psycho Crash
psychoCrash.flavorText: Perform an overhead punch, if landed, infuse your sword with cero energy, then slam down an energy burst, ignores ragdoll iframes.

balaSwarm.name: Bala Swarm
balaSwarm.flavorText: Fire a rapid volley of bala shots

chaoticBarrier.name: Chaotic Barrier
chaoticBarrier.flavorText: If you take 30+ damage in quick succession raise a kido barrier for 2 seconds, reducing 100% of the next attacks damage

ceroDestripador.name: Cero Destripador
ceroDestripador.flavorText: Fire sky-splitting lasers from your eyes. Ranged variant grants slippery fighter window on hit.

upgradeEffects.text: Gain access to a ranged variant which knocks enemies backwards, granting a window to utilize 'Slippery Fighter' or rushdown.
Landing your close range laser will cause you to leap into the air and bring your opponent down into the ground with you

highSpeedRegeneration.name: High Speed Regeneration
highSpeedRegeneration.flavorText: After taking 25% of your max health in damage while this is off cooldown, discard an injured limb for a new one, healing yourself based on skill level.

upgradeEffects.text: Survive an auto-execution, staying at 1 health and regrowing whatever was cut off. Has a cooldown of 120 seconds.

conjureWeapon.name: Conjure Weapon
conjureWeapon.flavorText: Conjure a basic spirit bow by pressing E.

heiligPfeil.name: Heilig Pfeil
heiligPfeil.flavorText: Conjure an arrow and throw it

advancedArchery.name: Advanced Archery
advancedArchery.flavorText: You are more in tune with your bow, allowing you to conjure a stronger bow and allowing access to the archery path. Allows mouse aim with your bow

luftpfeile.name: Luftpfeile
luftpfeile.flavorText: Leap forward into the air and fire an arrow straight down, blasting the ground below.

upgradeEffects.text: Luftpfeile can hit ragdolled/crumpled opponents
Press Counter during Luftpfeile's startup to slow your descent and float longer while charging a more powerful shot that crumples (1.2x dmg)

archerStratagem.name: Archer's Stratagem
archerStratagem.flavorText: You can now feint your bow fire, restore half of the cost on feint, empower your next arrow after a feint. You can fire again right after a feint, but feinting has a 3 second cooldown.

upgradeEffects.text: Restore full cost of the arrow on feint
Gain 3x swap speed to your spirit weapon after a feint
You can dash while charging your bow fire (no invincibility frames)
Bow fire shots that deal damage reduce the cooldown of Luftpfeile, Blitz Feuer, Leichter Sturm and Fallzwang by 4 seconds (once every 8 seconds)
Disable reiatsu regeneration
Disable transformations

leichterSturm.name: Leichter Sturm
leichterSturm.flavorText: Release a storm of arrows from your bow

upgradeEffects.text: Turnable for twice as long

fallzwang.name: Fallzwang
fallzwang.flavorText: Summon a bow that will fire an arrow to send airbone opponents back to the ground. (Target must be airbone)

upgradeEffects.text: Your arrow judges true, it must be parried to be avoided

heiligVerbegun.name: Heilig Verbegun
heiligVerbegun.flavorText: Call upon the power of the stars and charge your bow, then fire a massive blast from your bow

upgradeEffects.text: You blast executes low hp opponents.

bowConjurationUpgrade.name: Bow Conjuration Upgrade
bowConjurationUpgrade.flavorText: Your Spirit Bow is more powerful, reflected in a brand new appearance. Conjuring your bow during an M1 queues the swap for when the M1 ends. Landing an M1 makes your next bow shot 15% faster and 25% cheaper (lasts 2 seconds).

holyArrows.name: Holy Arrows
holyArrows.flavorText:
Your spirit bow's arrow now smite opponents with holy light once they are pierced

What it does: adds a flat +7.5 damage smite (+5 base) to the hit, the same at every skill level, and it scales with Kido Damage.
• Heilig Pfeil: +7.5 (Multi Shot: +7.5 on each of its 3 arrows)
• Luftpfeile: +7.5 (the Counter variant gets the same +7.5)
• Schnellepfeile: +7.5 on the last arrow
• Sterbe: +7.8 on the second hit
• Blitz Feuer: +12% on the 4 arrows after the grab

blitzFeuer.name: Blitz Feuer
blitzFeuer.flavorText: Rush at your opponent then leap into the air and unleash a volley of arrows

upgradeEffects.text: Blitz Feuer now gives rushdown

impalingArrows.name: Impaling Arrows
impalingArrows.flavorText: Your spirit bow's arrow now impale targets when charged for a bit

zangenpfeil.name: Zangenpfeil
zangenpfeil.flavorText: Fire an arrow capable of pinning opponents to it, and shredding through their internals. Enemies will experience bleeding both internally and externally when struck

blutArterie.name: Blut Arterie
blutArterie.flavorText: The offensive form of Blut which grants the user inhuman attack power. Allows artery fortifying at a basic level, and increasing damage & posture slightly

upgradeEffects.text: No longer passively saps Blut Bar during usage and increases weapon dmg by 4%
Increases weapon dmg by 6%
Increases weapon dmg by 8%
Increases weapon dmg by 11%
Increases weapon dmg by 15%
Mondlicht can hit ragdolled enemies
Press Counter after hitting an enemy/enemy's guard to do a follow-up attack
Landing follow-up attack refreshes rushdown cooldown

blutVene.name: Blut Vene
blutVene.flavorText: The defensive form of Blut, which grants the user inhuman durability

upgradeEffects.text: Increases defense by 4%
Increases defense by 6%
No longer passively saps Blut Bar during usage. Veins pulsate on your limbs. Increases defense by 8%
Increases defense by 10%
Increases defense by 12%
Increases defense by 14%
Increases defense by 16%
Increases defense by 17.5%

reishiGather.name: Reishi Gather
reishiGather.flavorText: Gather reiatsu from the atmosphere, increasing reiatsu regen rate by 7.5%

medallionSpecialist.name: Medallion Specialist
medallionSpecialist.flavorText: You have began specialization into your quincy medallion, allowing access to more advanced quincy spells, and you can switch between your bow at a faster rate

reishiFlash.name: Reishi Flash
reishiFlash.flavorText: Throw up an energy ball that blinds surrounding opponents

upgradeEffects.text: The first flare now burns your opponents retinas, causing excruciating pain, and stunning for a second

heiligPfeilPowerVariant.name: HeiligPfeilPowerVariant
heiligPfeilPowerVariant.flavorText: Heilig Pfeil arrow is much bigger and deals more damage, however is slower (12.5% dmg buff).

heiligPfeilSpeedVariant.name: HeiligPfeilSpeedVariant
heiligPfeilSpeedVariant.flavorText: Heilig Pfeil now fires a faster, weaker arrow (10% less dmg).

heiligPfeilMultiShotVariant.name: HeiligPfeilMultiShotVariant
heiligPfeilMultiShotVariant.flavorText: Heilig Pfeil now fires three weaker arrows at a s lower rate (10% less dmg).

beurteilung.name: Beurteilung
beurteilung.flavorText: Summon a massive spirit greatsword above your opponents head and then cast judgement on them, hits ragdolled opponents.

upgradeEffects.text: Inflicts bleed on enemies

reishigriff.name: Reishigriff
reishigriff.flavorText: Thieve your opponents reiryaku with a deadly chokehold. Restores blut charge on hit

upgradeEffects.text: Your chokehold steals a bit of reiatsu
Pressing Counter will now feint the skill

feurigeSaulen.name: Feurige Saulen
feurigeSaulen.flavorText: Summon forward pillars of holy fire

upgradeEffects.text: Feurige Saulen can hit ragdolled opponents
Holy flames linger where the pillars hit

brenschwerter.name: Brenschwerter
brenschwerter.flavorText: Summon six blistering blades at your side that lock onto your target, recast to fire them all at your initial target.

upgradeEffects.text: Summon 2 more blades, for 8 in total, no change in total posture damage

klingenfallen.name: Klingenfallen
klingenfallen.flavorText: Summon a blade into your hand and hurl it forward where it spins in place and shreds anything it catches.

upgradeEffects.text: Inflicts bleed on enemies
The blade returns to you after spinning

schlagen.name: Schlagen
schlagen.flavorText: Summon a raging thunderstorm, and then strike lightning on the blast zone

upgradeEffects.text: Attacking people with the blast zone heals you for 5% max HP
Create rushdown window on impact
Schlagen electrocutes opponents

klingensturm.name: Klingensturm
klingensturm.flavorText: Summon various spirit weapons once used by your deceased comrades to rain down warfare on your target

upgradeEffects.text: Applies a after-shock that deals a small % of the abilities damage when landed
[300+ KIDO] The Hado spell is upgraded to 'Jugeki Byakurai', increasing the range, piercing through riposte armor, and changing the color to red

sai.name: Sai
sai.flavorText: Lock an opponent's hands together preventing them from attacking. Ineffective against stronger opponents

upgradeEffects.text: Your sai now ignores block

sho.name: Sho
sho.flavorText: Knockback opponents, even when they are knocked

upgradeEffects.text: Sho prevents enemies from getting up from a knocked state while active
Sho can wallbang enemies
Seals reiatsu while active

bindResist.name: Bind Resist
bindResist.flavorText: Reduce the duration of kido-based binding techniques used on you, additionally provides a small dmg reduction against any kido-based attacks

sekienton.name: Sekienton
sekienton.flavorText: Red smoke which stuns and deals minor damage. Hitting an opponent with the edge of the move or hitting a crumpled opponent will send them flying into the air

upgradeEffects.text: You can rushdown after sending an opponent into the air

horin.name: Horin
horin.flavorText: A kido rope that pulls in a targetted enemy. Works on ragdolled opponents

upgradeEffects.text: Horin can now pull wallbanged opponents
Horin goes through block

rikujokoro.name: Rikujokoro
rikujokoro.flavorText: Summon 6 beams of light to pierce an opponent and temporarily restrict their movement

geki.name: Geki
geki.flavorText: Upon guardbreak, bind the enemy in red energy. Extends guardbreak duration by a moderate amount

reactiveBarrier.name: Reactive Barrier
reactiveBarrier.flavorText: If you take 40+ damage in quick succession raise a kido barrier for 2s reducing 100% of the next attacks damage

trapSpell.name: Trap Spell
trapSpell.flavorText: Create a motion detecting trap. Press Counter durin startup to transition into a flip attack (landing the flip attack will deal less damage)

hainawa.name: Hainawa
hainawa.flavorText: Lightning tendrils which steal reiatsu from your opponent

goryutenmetsu.name: Goryutenmetsu
goryutenmetsu.flavorText: Summon dragons behind you that you can send one-by-one to your mouse position/targeted opponent

upgradeEffects.text: Summon an extra dragon
Summon another extra dragon

danku.name: Danku
danku.flavorText:
Create a defensive wall to protect against enemy attacks. Casting Kido is possible while the wall is in effect.

Passive: Blocking Kido attacks will restore some reiatsu, and after using the move your next kido move is automatically perfect casted.

upgradeEffects.text: Casting Danku during the chant minigame of another Kido spell is now possible

hyapporankan.name: Hyapporankan
hyapporankan.flavorText: Throw a rod of kido that splits into many, pinning the first opponent struck and carrying them into the nearest wall

upgradeEffects.text: Having Tsuzuri Raiden buffs all forms of lightining damage
Parrying attacks with Tsuzuri Raiden active will restore 12.5% more posture

fushibi.name: Fushibi
fushibi.flavorText: Stun the enemy with a net of kido before it explodes

upgradeEffects.text: Fushibi disables the dash/flashstep of those caught in the web initially for a brief duration

sokatsui.name: Sokatsui
sokatsui.flavorText: Conjure a blinding continuous energy beam in front of you

raikoho.name: Raikoho
raikoho.flavorText: A chargeable lightining projectile which implodes upon impact, sucking entities in.

upgradeEffects.text: Rushdown potential off knockback
After-shock that allows for follow up

zangerin.name: Zangerin
zangerin.flavorText: Perform a AOE slash attack imbued with lightning, after a short window, if attacked, Zangerin will deal massively more damage and create rushdown options (Not for late counters)

upgradeEffects.text: If Tsuzuri Raiden is active, then the damage of Zangerin is increased
Zangerin causes electroshock, increasing stun time heavily. This effect is heavily amplified on early counter, and slightly on late counter.

electricalEnergy.name: Electrical Energy
electricalEnergy.flavorText: Moves that deal electric damage are now more potent

reiatsuEnhancement.name: Reiatsu Enhancement
reiatsuEnhancement.flavorText: Parrying a kido-type attack will absorb its energy into your blade empowering your next melee attac

haien.name: Haien
haien.flavorText: A blast of purple energy which incinerates a target upon contact

upgradeEffects.text: Purple flames linger after the attack hits

gakiRekko.name: Gaki Rekko
gakiRekko.flavorText: Create a circle of energy before firing multiple blasts of green light from its center

upgradeEffects.text: Press Counter during startup to shoot the blasts into the air, raining down upon a opponent after a delay
Gaki Rekko can now hit wallbanged players.

okasen.name: Okasen
okasen.flavorText: Generate a yellow orb, charging to fire a wide arc of electrical energy

upgradeEffects.text: You can rushdown off Okasen upon perfect casting
After shock that allows for follow up
Concusses enemies

heavenCullingSear.name: Heaven Culling-Sear
heavenCullingSear.flavorText: Summon heavenly orbs to devastate your opponents, does not require full ultimate bar. If cast with full ultimate bar, summons double the orbs.

senseNode1.name: Sensory 1
senseNode1.flavorText: Decrease the minimum range needed to sense someone

senseNode2.name: Sensory 2
senseNode2.flavorText: View the reiatsu grade of the entities that you sense

senseNode3.name: Sensory 3
senseNode3.flavorText: View the factions of the entities that you sense

senseNode4.name: Sensory 4
senseNode4.flavorText: View an approximate powerlevel of the entities that you sense

morale-starter.name: Morale Starter
morale-starter.flavorText: Give buffs to others, while debuffing monsters. This applies the Inner fire monster dmg buff and healing salve buff to people around you.

soul-ward.name: Soul Ward
soul-ward.flavorText: Shield nearby party members with a barrier that absorbs incoming damage, protecting them from statuses and executes until it breaks.

guiding-light.name: Guiding Light
guiding-light.flavorText: Bless nearby party members, increasing their health, reiatsu and defense. You are blessed as well if at least one ally is.

lifeline.name: Lifeline
lifeline.flavorText: Revive downed party members around you, restoring a portion of their health.

inner-fire.name: Inner Fire
